# Master’s Degree Program

Eligibility Requirements for the Master’s Degree Program

MSc/MEng: 2 Year ProgramMS/MA: 1 Year ProgramMBA: 2 Year and 1 Year ProgramPM: 1 Year Program

To be eligible for admission to the regular Master’s program, an applicant must:

* Hold a Bachelor’s degree (normally from a four-year program), or its equivalent, in an appropriate field of study from an institution of good standing acceptable to AIT;
* Have undergraduate grades significantly above average; the minimum cGPA requirement for admission to the Master’s Program is 2.75 or equivalent, at the Bachelor’s degree level;
* English Proficiency Requirement: AIT-EET: 6; IELTS Academic: overall 6 (writing 6); TOEFL iBT: overall 80 (writing 21-23); & PTE Academic: overall 52 (writing 62-73)
* Be in satisfactory physical and mental health, and have a record of good conduct;
* For the P

Have undergraduate grades significantly above average.
* The minimum GPA requirement for admission to the Masters Program is 2.75 or equivalent, at the Bachelor degree level;
* English Proficiency Requirement: AIT-EET:6 or IELTS- Academic:6 (writing 6) or TOEFL Paper: 550 (writing 59-61) or TOEFL CBT: 213 (writing 25-26): TOEFL IBT: 80 (writing 21-23);
* For the PM degree program, in addition to the above-mentioned eligibility requirements, an applicant must: have at least 3 years of work experience in areas related to the academic program at AIT and be executives in organizations/companies.
* Be in satisfactory physical and mental health.
* Satisfy English requirements by AIT.

## Delivery Mode and Other Features

The program will be delivered onsite in the AIT Vietnam campus during 1 year of full time studying, and in every weekday evening from 18:00-21:00, and Saturday from 9:00 – 12:00 & 13:30 – 16:30. Hybrid mode is available for those who are not able to join on-site.

Admission

* Be in satisfactory physical and mental health, and have a record of good conduct;

Eligibility Requirements for the Master’s Degree Program

MSc/MEng: 2 Year ProgramMS/MA: 1 Year ProgramMBA: 2 Year and 1 Year ProgramPM: 1 Year Program

To be eligible for admission to the regular Master’s program, an applicant must:

* Hold a Bachelor’s degree (normally from a four-year program), or its equivalent, in an appropriate field of study from an institution of good standing acceptable to AIT;
* Have undergraduate grades significantly above average; the minimum cGPA requirement for admission to the Master’s Program is 2.75 or equivalent, at the Bachelor’s degree level;
* English Proficiency Requirement: AIT-EET: 6; IELTS Academic: overall 6 (writing 6); TOEFL iBT: overall 80 (writing 21-23); & PTE Academic: overall 52 (writing 62-73)

anagement Decision-Making

To be eligible for admission to the regular Doctoral degree program, an applicant must:

## Delivery Mode

Eligibility Requirements for theCertificate and Special Program

Certificate Program

Certificate students need to satisfy the eligibility requirements similar to those entering the master’s degree program and have the appropriate background to take selected courses. In exceptional cases, candidates who lack formal academic qualifications but who have extensive and appropriate professional experience may be considered for admission; the discretion in such cases rests with the School Deans.

Special Program (Exchange and Visiting Students)

# Flexible Master’s Option

The “Flexible Master’s Option” is a new alternative to our traditional “On-campus Master Option” to conduct Master studies at AIT. It is applicable to selected programs at all of our schools. Students will receive the same degree and the same academic requirements apply as the program offered in our regular “On-campus Option”. Students can do almost all coursework online via AIT’s Hybrid Mode of Instruction (certain programs may require a lab and research work on campus).

## How it Works

Typically, the 1st year is online via AIT’s Hybrid Instruction. Students may spread coursework over more than one year. Students take the same course offered to on-campus students via Hybrid Mode. All classes are recorded for later viewing.

After completion of the coursework, students can do their research or thesis in the AIT Campus at a flexible time.

Prospective students at AIT have the following study options:

1. **Open Master of Engineering Science in Interdisciplinary Studies (OMIS)**: This program allows students to choose from all courses offered by AIT, create a unique curriculum, and blend engineering with business and sustainability. It offers three curriculum structures:
   - 24-credit coursework + 24-credit thesis
   - 24-credit coursework + 12-credit internship or exchange + 12-credit research study
   - 36-credit coursework + 12-credit research study

2. **Flexible Master’s Option**: This is an alternative to the traditional on-campus master’s program. It allows students to complete most coursework online via AIT’s Hybrid Mode of Instruction, with the option to attend classes on campus. Students can complete coursework over more than one year and must complete their research or thesis on campus. The fastest completion time is 2 academic years, with a maximum study period of 4 academic years.

3. **International Exchange Programs**: Students can participate in exchange programs with partner universities, transferring eligible graduate courses under specific conditions. Details on credit transfer and scholarships are available through AIT’s exchange coordinators.

For the Flexible Master’s Option, students must register for a minimum of 2 courses (6 credits) per semester and a maximum of 15 credits. Payment can be made via money transfer, and students may attend classes on campus if desired.

# Data Science and AI (DSAI)

#### Area of Specializationunder theComputer Science and Communication Technology (CSCT)program

Data Science (DS)is concerned with the extraction of useful knowledge from data sets.  It is closely related to the fields of computer science, mathematics, and statistics.  It is a relatively new term for a broad set of skills spanning the more established fields of machine learning, data mining, databases, and visualization, along with their applications in various fields.  In 2012, Harvard Business Review called data science “The Sexiest Job of the 21stCentury”.

Artificial Intelligence (AI)is the broad field conceived in 1956 as the automation or simulation of human intelligence.  AI has two primary “levels”.  The first level, “narrow AI”, concerns perception, statistical inference, and actuation, drawing on data science, sensors, and robo

To apply for a PhD in the Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), the requirements include:

1. **Academic Background**: Hold a four-year bachelor’s degree and a master’s degree from an institution of good standing. The minimum CGPA requirement for the master’s degree is 3.50 or equivalent. Applicants with a one-year master’s degree, a one-year professional master’s degree, or a one-year postgraduate diploma must complete an additional 12-25 credits of coursework, achieve a CGPA of 3.5, and obtain very good or excellent grades in their research study.

2. **English Proficiency**: Meet AIT’s English proficiency requirements, such as:
   - AIT-EET: 6
   - IELTS Academic: overall 6 (writing 6)
   - TOEFL iBT: overall 80 (writing 21-23)
   - PTE Academic: overall 52 (writing 62-73)

3. **Research Proposal**: Submit a brief outline of the dissertation research proposal (5-10 pages), including the required research facilities, if necessary.

4. **Recommendation Letters**: Provide two recommendation letters.

5. **Application Process**: Apply through the AIT online admission portal. No separate application form is needed. Applicants may describe their interest in scholarships in their statement of purpose, which can be uploaded as a separate file.

6. **Scholarship Eligibility**: AIT offers scholarships for eligible candidates, which can only be awarded once before enrollment and cannot be changed during the study period. Applicants must seek approval from the School Dean for the scholarship grant.

7. **Flexible PhD Option**: For the Flexible PhD Option, applicants can study remotely, pay course-by-course, and register for a minimum of 6 credits per semester. The cost is the same as the regular on-campus option, and all schools provide scholarships for eligible candidates.

Applicants with a one-year master’s degree, a one-year professional master’s degree, or a one-year postgraduate diploma must complete an additional 12-25 credits of coursework, achieve a CGPA of 3.5, and obtain very good or excellent grades in their research study.

2. **English Proficiency**: Meet AIT’s English proficiency requirements, such as:
   - AIT-EET: 6
   - IELTS Academic: overall 6 (writing 6)
   - TOEFL iBT: overall 80 (writing 21-23)
   - PTE Academic: overall 52 (writing 62-73)

3. **Research Proposal**: Submit a brief outline of the dissertation research proposal (5-10 pages), including the required research facilities, if necessary.

4. **Recommendation Letters**: Provide two recommendation letters.

AIT offers several scholarship options for eligible students, primarily for Master’s and Doctoral programs. These scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis to outstanding applicants and are provided by AIT itself or through donor funds. The scholarships can cover full or partial tuition fees, but students are still responsible for registration fees (20,000 Baht per semester) and living expenses (around 11,500–15,000 Baht per month).

te, the AIT Scholarships are intended to increase the number of skilled international scientists, engineers, and managers required to meet the future challenges of the emerging Asian Economic Community region and beyond.

AIT Scholarships are a form of financial aid that provides an opportunity for students from all over the world to study together at AIT. It helps subsidize part of the study cost by covering full, or a portion of, tuition fees only for qualified students, while the students are responsible for the rest of the tuition, the registration fees (20,000 Baht per semester to maintain student status), and the living expenses (around 11,500‐15,000 Baht per month).

Each Faculty/School has its Selection Committee. The Selection Committee will propose the value of the AIT Scholarships grant for each applicant (if eligible) for approval by the School Dean. This AIT Scholarship grant can only be awarded once before enrollment and cannot be changed during the entire study period.

# AIT Alumni Scholarship Fund

In early January 2021, we launched the first AIT Alumni Scholarship Fund to provide financial support to qualified Master’s students facing economic challenges. The total amount collected will be distributed amongst theFaculties and the School

CRITERIA:1. Any nationality2. Any program3 . Candidate should have a cumulative GPA of at least 2.754  . Candidate should pass IELTS-Academic with a score of 6.0 or AIT EET Score of 6.05   .Applicant must fulfill the AIT Admissions Entry Requirements

Scholarships coverage: 2 credits up to 6 credits

Deadline for August 2026 Intake: 10 June 2026

Interested applicants should apply through the AITonline admissionportal. No separate application to fill out.

Applicants may provide additional details in their statement of purpose in seeking this Scholarship. This can be in a separate file and

undergraduate program from an accredited institution in related fields;GPA for Bachelor’s degree ≥ 3.5or Equivalent
* Have an English proficiency score as specified byAIT Language Center(IELTS 6.0 (Overall and Writing bands) or AIT EET ≥ 6.0).

## Coverage

Each scholarship award covers tuition fees, accommodation, and a bursary for living expenses in AIT’s residential campus, for the entire period of the 22-month master’s degree program. The value of the non-binding Scholarship per student is approximately 1.10 MB.

## Deadline for August 2026 Intake: 31 March 2026

Interested applicants can apply through the AITonline admissionportal. No separate application to fill out. Applicants may describe in their statement of purpose seeking this scholarship. This can be in a separate file and uploaded to the application portal.

Students, who are married and wish to bring their families to AIT, need to submit a copy of passport and a copy of marriage certificate or evidence to support the marital status. we do not provide a student visa for the time you conduct the online coursework. We will help you to obtain a student visa for the Master Thesis if you write the thesis on AIT campus.
Will I have an AIT email?

Yes, as an AIT student, you will have an AIT student email account during the study period.
Can I come to the AIT campus for my thesis?

Yes, you can come to the campus and stay on campus at our student residences. If you may prefer, you can stay for 2 semesters to complete your thesis on a full-time basis. Individuals whose qualifications are considered acceptable and who have requested to be attached to the Institute to do research are considered for an appointment as `Fellows of AIT’. A Fellow of AIT has the privilege to use Institute research facilities, the library and recreational facilities and may audit courses with the permission of the instructor. To apply, candidates must submit to the relevant School anAIT Application (Form 1), a copy of CV and a research study plan. Fellows of AIT are endorsed by the relevant School Deans and are formally invited to the Institute by the Vice President for Academic Affairs.

6. What is the AIT English Entry Test (AIT-EET)?

AIT offers a diverse pool of postgraduate students (Master’s and PhD) specializing in fields such as engineering and technology, environment, resources and development, and management. Most students are international and multilingual, with strong academic and professional backgrounds.

# PAGE: Master's Degree Program - Asian Institute of Technology
URL: https://ait.ac.th/eligibility/masters-degree-program/

# Master’s Degree Program

Eligibility Requirements for the Master’s Degree Program

MSc/MEng: 2 Year ProgramMS/MA: 1 Year ProgramMBA: 2 Year and 1 Year ProgramPM: 1 Year Program

To be eligible for admission to the regular Master’s program, an applicant must:

* Hold a Bachelor’s degree (normally from a four-year program), or its equivalent, in an appropriate field of study from an institution of good standing acceptable to AIT;
* Have undergraduate grades significantly above average; the minimum cGPA requirement for admission to the Master’s Program is 2.75 or equivalent, at the Bachelor’s degree level;
* English Proficiency Requirement: AIT-EET: 6; IELTS Academic: overall 6 (writing 6); TOEFL iBT: overall 80 (writing 21-23); & PTE Academic: overall 52 (writing 62-73)
* Be in satisfactory physical and mental health, and have a record of good conduct;
* For the P

admission to the Masters Program is 2.75 or equivalent, at the Bachelor degree level;
* English Proficiency Requirement: AIT-EET:6 or IELTS- Academic:6 (writing 6) or TOEFL Paper: 550 (writing 59-61) or TOEFL CBT: 213 (writing 25-26): TOEFL IBT: 80 (writing 21-23);
* For the PM degree program, in addition to the above-mentioned eligibility requirements, an applicant must: have at least 3 years of work experience in areas related to the academic program at AIT and be executives in organizations/companies.
* Be in satisfactory physical and mental health.
* Satisfy English requirements by AIT.

## Delivery Mode

The program is delivered using a combination of methods such as interactive self-learning, live classroom, face-to-face classroom in AIT campus. Each course (except the integrative module) will be delivered over 3 to 4 weeks. The program will attempt to provide options for participants to attend all or part of the integrative module on campus, considering the participants’ work sc

nrollment with your academic program. There are no additional cost in pursuing a minor. A total of 12 credits in the minor program are required.
7. Is all communication and all documents and teaching material in English?

Yes, AIT is an English speaking campus. All communication is in English, more details under FAQ number 5 under the requirements.
8. What are Unified programs?

Unified Programs integrate undergraduate studies with graduate studies into a seamless “Unified” program. For example, undergraduate students may join AIT in their final year to complete their undergraduate degree and at the same time start their Master program at AIT. 6. What is the AIT English Entry Test (AIT-EET)?

The Language Center (LC) offers a 90-minute in-house test of English proficiency called the AIT English Entry Test (EET). The score is based on a nine-point scale similar to the IELTS test. generation.answer_text:
To determine your eligibility for the Professional Master’s (PM) program, you must meet the following criteria:

1. **Academic Qualification**: Hold a Bachelor’s degree (normally from a four-year program) or its equivalent in an appropriate field from an institution of good standing.
2. **Minimum GPA**: Undergraduate grades significantly above average; the minimum cGPA requirement is 2.75 or equivalent.
3. **English Proficiency**: Meet one of the following:
   - AIT-EET: 6
   - IELTS-Academic: 6 (writing 6)
   - TOEFL Paper: 550 (writing 59-61)
   - TOEFL CBT: 213 (writing 25-26)
   - TOEFL IBT: 80 (writing 21-23)
4. **Work Experience**: Have at least 3 years of work experience in areas related to the academic program at AIT.
5. **Executive Role**: Be an executive in an organization or company.
6. **Health and Conduct**: Be in satisfactory physical and mental health and have a record of good conduct.

If you meet all these requirements, you are eligible for the Professional Master’s program.

## Upon Enrolment – Academic Issues
1. Does the Institute apply the class attendance system?

All students are expected to attend their classes as per the semester class schedules.

AIT offers a diverse pool of postgraduate students (Master’s and PhD) specializing in fields such as engineering and technology, environment, resources and development, and management. Most students are international and multilingual, with strong academic and professional backgrounds.

Definitely. We can help connect you with students who are seeking internship placements or research collaboration. Please contact us directly atcareercenter@ait.ac.thwith your specific requirements.

#### What is the typical internship period at AIT?

Internships at AIT are flexible and vary depending on the academic program. # English Proficiency Requirement For Admission

AIT is an international institute with a mission to serve as a platform for international students from the full spectrum of highly developed to less developed countries. Its residential campus is today a small replica of the world without borders. The “Flexible Master’s Option” is a new alternative to our traditional “On-campus Master Option” to conduct Master studies at AIT. It is applicable to selected programs at all of our schools. Students will receive the same degree and the same academic requirements apply as the program offered in our regular “On-campus Option”. Students can do almost all coursework online via AIT’s Hybrid Mode of Instruction (certain programs may require a lab and research work on campus).

## How it Works

Typically, the 1st year is online via AIT’s Hybrid Instruction. Students may spread coursework over more than one year. Students take the same course offered to on-campus students via Hybrid Mode. All classes are recorded for later viewing.

After completion of the coursework, students can do their research or thesis in the AIT Campus at a flexible time.

The application is currently open.

## Payment

First, you need to decide for how many courses you want to enrollee, the minimum enrollment is 6 credits which is equivalent to 2 courses. The Program Secretary can advise you on details. You need to pay the full fee for your courses before the start of the semester.All details to make payments are at this website,Click here.

## Contact & Support

For More Inquiry, please contact:admissions@ait.ac.th

URL: https://ait.ac.th/study/flexible-masters-option/

# Flexible Master’s Option

The “Flexible Master’s Option” is a new alternative to our traditional “On-campus Master Option” to conduct Master studies at AIT. It is applicable to selected programs at all of our schools. Students will receive the same degree and the same academic requirements apply as the program offered in our regular “On-campus Option”. Students can do almost all coursework online via AIT’s Hybrid Mode of Instruction (certain programs may require a lab and research work on campus).

## How it Works

Typically, the 1st year is online via AIT’s Hybrid Instruction. Students may spread coursework over more than one year. Students take the same course offered to on-campus students via Hybrid Mode. All classes are recorded for later viewing.

After completion of the coursework, students can do their research or thesis in the AIT Campus at a flexible time.

Agriculture plays a vital role in the economic development of a majority of developing countries. Moreover, agriculture is the provider of food and feed to the world. The agro-industries are also contributing to the growing industrialization of developing countries leading to the increasing importance of agri-products. The development of agribusinesses is also influenced by trade policies. Semiconductor Engineering Program of the Department of Industrial Systems Engineering (ISE) of the Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), Thailand and MS in Semiconductor Engineering of Innovation Frontier Institute of Research for Science and Technology at the National Taipei University of Technology (Taipei Tech), Taiwan.

the Dual Degree

The objective of this dual degree program is to prepare students for careers in semiconductor engineering, integrated circuit design, microelectronics, and related fields, by providing a strong theoretical and practical foundation that is necessary for careers in various sectors such as engineering consultancy, research, and academia.

## Advantages

* Students are awarded two Master’s degrees in two years: one from the Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), Thailand, and one from the National Taipei University of Technology (Taipei Tech), Taiwan.
* Students have the opportunity to network by studying in two institutions at AIT and Taipei Tech, enhancing both technical expertise and global practices in semiconductor engineering.
* Students acquire knowledge and skills from a comprehensive curriculum offered by both AIT and Taipei Tech, covering key aspects of semiconductor engineering, with opportunities to specialize in advanced topics like VLSI design, microelectronic

a comprehensive curriculum offered by both AIT and Taipei Tech, covering key aspects of semiconductor engineering, with opportunities to specialize in advanced topics like VLSI design, microelectronics, and automation technology.
* Students have the benefit of collaborating with AIT and Taipei Tech faculty and utilizing advanced research facilities to enhance their research study.

## Target Group

This program is designed for highly motivated candidates, including fresh graduates and mid-level professionals with a background in Electrical Engineering or related fields, seeking global expertise in semiconductor engineering.

## Minimum Admission Requirements

* Holds a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field (normally from a four-year program), or its equivalent.
* Have undergraduate grades significantly above average; the minimum GPA requirement for admission is 3.0 or equivalent.
* English proficiency requirement: IELTS 6.5 (writing 6 minimum) or TOEFL

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview by faculty from both universities. Successful candidates will be jointly admitted to both AIT and Taipei Tech and will begin their studies at the designated institution.

## Scholarships & Internship Opportunities

AIT and Taipei Tech offer scholarships and assistantships based on academic performance to help cover tuition and living expenses. Students will also have the opportunity to undertake internships at Delta Electronics (Thailand) and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited(TSMC).

# Dual Degree Master’s Program in Water Engineering and Management with the University of Iowa (USA)

MEng/MSc in Water Engineering and Management from the Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), Thailand, and MSc in Civil and Environmental Engineering from the University of Iowa (UI), USA

## About the Program

This program will prepare students for careers in hydrology and hydraulics by providing them with a strong foundation that includes both the theoretical and applied study of fluids. Students will receive the broad-based academic background needed for a career in engineering design, research, consulting, or academia. The AIT brings 60 years of regional experience in water education and research, complemented by the Univers

mic background needed for a career in engineering design, research, consulting, or academia. The AIT brings 60 years of regional experience in water education and research, complemented by the University of Iowa’s century of global leadership in fluids-related teaching and research, including experimentation (both laboratory and field-scale) and mathematical modeling.

Dual Degree Structure & Pathway

## Admission Requirements

* Hold a bachelor’s degree (normally from a four-year program), or its equivalent
* The minimum undergraduate GPA requirement for admission to the master’s program is 3.0 or equivalent
* AIT:IELTS-Academic: 6 (writing 6)TOEFL Paper: 550 (writing 59-61)TOELF CBT: 213 (writing 25-26)TOEFL IBT: 80 (writing 21-23)
* UI:TOEFL IBT: 81IELTS: total score of 7.0 (no sub-score less than 6.0)
* Students satisfying the AIT requirement can be admitted to the program; however, to continue to Phase 2, students must achieve the UI scores for English proficiency while at AIT.

# Environmental Engineering and Management (EEM)

## Introduction / Background

Environmental Engineering at AIT began in 1964 with the need for sanitary engineering to address the problems of providing adequate water supplies and sanitation facilities. This pioneering environmental engineering program has grown into a range of fields needed to tackle the emerging environmental issues facing Asia today.

By integrating multidisciplinary learning and research-driven approaches, the program  contributes directly to advancing the global sustainability agenda, particularly in areas such as climate action, clean air, water and sanitation, sustainable urban development, and responsible resource management. Through active collaboration with public and private sectors, the program is designed to strengthen regional capacity, support ev

determine economic growth, human well-being, and ecological integrity.

The Water Engineering and Management (WEM) program at AIT aims to address these contemporary challenges in water resources and its sustainable development and management. WEM program integrates the engineering, management, and policy dimensions of water and provides students with a unique blend of knowledge and skills on fundamentals of water resources such as hydrology, hydraulics, irrigation and drainage, hydro-informatics and modeling, while embedding the essence of climate change adaptation, risk management, water governance, and socioeconomic consideration. The program equips students with technical knowledge and management strategies to manage water resources sustainably across scales, from local watersheds to international river basins.

# Telecommunications (TC)

The Telecommunications program offers areas of specialization in transmission systems; switching systems; telematics; network planning, and in collaboration with the School of Management, telecommunications management.

The courses offered to emphasize modern telecommunications skills in systems planning and engineering, telecommunications software development, and administrative and financial aspects of telecommunications management.

Graduates from the master’s program form the nucleus for effective high-level technical planning and management operations at their employer organizations. Some of the graduates are engaged in planning, development, and service activities leading to the installation, commissioning, management, design, etc. of value-added systems. Given the important role of our graduates in the development of the telecommunicat

strategies for cellular-mobile and cabled networks, as well as questions of congestion control and new services in ISDN and future B-ISDN networks.

* Transmission systems
* Telematics
* Network planning
* Coherent optical communications
* Multiple-access strategies

* Congestion control

Undergraduate study for candidates seeking admission to the field of Telecommunications are in communications, telecommunications, electrical engineering, electronics, and computer science or computer engineering. # Water Engineering and Management (WEM)

## Introduction / Background

The availability, management, and sustainable use of water resources have become a defining challenge of this century. Water is now at the center of global debates on climate resilience, food and energy security, sustainable cities, disaster risk reduction, and environmental protection. Yet, many regions, particularly developing nations, continue to struggle with floods, droughts, pollution, and competing sectoral demands. These challenges are further amplified in Asia, the world’s most populous and climate-vulnerable region, where effective water management will directly determine economic growth, human well-being, and ecological integrity.

The Water Engineering and Management (WEM) program at AIT aims to address these contemporary challenges in water resources and i

determine economic growth, human well-being, and ecological integrity.

The Water Engineering and Management (WEM) program at AIT aims to address these contemporary challenges in water resources and its sustainable development and management. WEM program integrates the engineering, management, and policy dimensions of water and provides students with a unique blend of knowledge and skills on fundamentals of water resources such as hydrology, hydraulics, irrigation and drainage, hydro-informatics and modeling, while embedding the essence of climate change adaptation, risk management, water governance, and socioeconomic consideration. The program equips students with technical knowledge and management strategies to manage water resources sustainably across scales, from local watersheds to international river basins.

generation.answer_text:
For an overseas applicant applying for the **January intake** at **AIT (Assumption University)** and requiring an **educational visa**, the relevant deadlines and guidelines are as follows:

### **Key Deadlines for January Intake**
1. **General Deadline for Overseas Applicants (Educational Visa):**  
   - **20 December** is the deadline for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa for the **January Semester/Term Intake** (as stated in sources [2] and [3]).  
   - However, some sources (e.g., [4][7]) mention **30 June** as the deadline for overseas applicants needing an educational visa for the **August Semester/Term Intake** (which corresponds to the January academic year start). This discrepancy may arise from differing interpretations of "January intake" (e.g., whether it refers to the academic term starting in January or the application cycle for that term).  

   **Clarification:**  
   - If the January intake refers to the **academic term starting in January**, the **20 December** deadline applies.  
   - If the January intake refers to the **August application cycle** (common in Thai universities), the **30 June** deadline applies.  
   - Always confirm with AIT’s admissions team to resolve ambiguity.

---

### **Educational Visa Requirements**
1. **Visa Type:**  
   - Apply for a **non-immigrant visa (ED plus)** for degree programs.  
   - For exchange or visiting students, apply for **ED** visa (special programs).  
   - **Avoid tourist visas (T)**, as they will result in immediate deportation.  

2. **Documents Required:**  
   - AIT’s **visa request letter** and **Certificate of Admission**.  
   - Passport with valid visa (ED/ED plus).  
   - Additional documents may be requested by Thai embassies (e.g., proof of funds, academic transcripts).  

3. **Application Process:**  
   - Submit the visa application to the **Thai Embassy/Consulate** promptly.  
   - Ensure the visa is valid before arriving in Thailand.  

---

### **Scholarship Deadlines (Relevant for Visa Applicants)**
- **30 June** is the deadline for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa for **AIT Scholarships** (including RTG Fellowships) under the August Semester/Term Intake (January intake).  
- Other scholarships (e.g., HM King’s/Queen’s, GMS, ADB-JSP) have earlier deadlines (e.g., 31 March).  

---

### **Important Notes**
- **Conflicting Deadlines:** Some sources list **20 December** for January intake, while others list **30 June** for August Semester/Term Intake. This may depend on the specific faculty or program. Verify with AIT’s admissions office.  
- **Visa Application:** Always apply for the correct visa type (ED/ED plus) and ensure all documents are submitted well in advance.  

For further details, refer to AIT’s official guidelines: [AIT Visa Guidelines](https://ait.ac.th/guidelines-for-applicants-who-were-offered-admission/).

generation.answer_text:
For an overseas applicant applying for the **January intake** at **AIT (Assumption University)** and requiring an **educational visa**, the relevant deadlines and guidelines are as follows:

### **Key Deadlines for January Intake**
1. **General Deadline for Overseas Applicants (Educational Visa):**  
   - **20 December** is the deadline for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa for the **January Semester/Term Intake** (as stated in sources [2] and [3]).  
   - However, some sources (e.g., [4][7]) mention **30 June** as the deadline for overseas applicants needing an educational visa for the **August Semester/Term Intake** (which corresponds to the January academic year start). This discrepancy may arise from differing interpretations of "January intake" (e.g., whether it refers to the academic term starting in January or the application cycle for that term).  

   **Clarification:**  
   - If the January intake refers to the **academic term starting in January**, the **20 December** deadline applies.  
   - If the January intake refers to the **August application cycle** (common in Thai universities), the **30 June** deadline applies.  
   - Always confirm with AIT’s admissions team to resolve ambiguity.

---

### **Educational Visa Requirements**
1. **Visa Type:**  
   - Apply for a **non-immigrant visa (ED plus)** for degree programs.  
   - For exchange or visiting students, apply for **ED** visa (special programs).  
   - **Avoid tourist visas (T)**, as they will result in immediate deportation.  

2. **Documents Required:**  
   - AIT’s **visa request letter** and **Certificate of Admission**.  
   - Passport with valid visa (ED/ED plus).  
   - Additional documents may be requested by Thai embassies (e.g., proof of funds, academic transcripts).  

3. **Application Process:**  
   - Submit the visa application to the **Thai Embassy/Consulate** promptly.  
   - Ensure the visa is valid before arriving in Thailand.  

---

### **Scholarship Deadlines (Relevant for Visa Applicants)**
- **30 June** is the deadline for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa for **AIT Scholarships** (including RTG Fellowships) under the August Semester/Term Intake (January intake).  
- Other scholarships (e.g., HM King’s/Queen’s, GMS, ADB-JSP) have earlier deadlines (e.g., 31 March).  

---

### **Important Notes**
- **Conflicting Deadlines:** Some sources list **20 December** for January intake, while others list **30 June** for August Semester/Term Intake. This may depend on the specific faculty or program. Verify with AIT’s admissions office.  
- **Visa Application:** Always apply for the correct visa type (ED/ED plus) and ensure all documents are submitted well in advance.  

For further details, refer to AIT’s official guidelines: [AIT Visa Guidelines](https://ait.ac.th/guidelines-for-applicants-who-were-offered-admission/).

For the **August Semester/Term Intake** (which corresponds to the **January Intake** in the academic year), **overseas applicants requiring an educational visa** must meet the following deadline:  

- **30 June** is the deadline for overseas applicants requiring an educational visa.  

This date is explicitly mentioned in multiple contexts ([1](#context1), [5](#context5), [6](#context6)), and it applies to programs under the **Faculty of Infrastructure, Faculty of Technology, Faculty of Resource, Faculty of Climate Change, Faculty of Public Policy, and the School of Management (SOM)**.  

Other related deadlines for the August intake include:  
- **25 July** for other applicants (not requiring a visa).  
- **31 March** for scholarship applications (e.g., ADB-JSP, Bangchak, etc.).  

For visa-related queries, ensure you apply by **30 June** to align with the educational visa requirements.  

**Note**: If you are applying for a different intake (e.g., January or October), the deadlines will vary (e.g., 20 December for January Intake, 15 September for October Intake). Always confirm the specific program’s requirements.
